===== src/components/Button.tsx
// Generated by OpenFini Proto from the design's component. Edit the design and export again, or take it over.
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { IconCheck } from "./IconCheck";
import { cx } from "../cx";

export interface ButtonProps {
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
  state?: "default" | "hover" | "disabled";
  label?: string;
  icon?: ReactNode;
  showIcon?: boolean;
  children?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

const VARIANTS: Record<string, string> = {
  "sm/default": "md-default",
  "sm/hover": "md-default",
  "sm/disabled": "md-default",
  "md/default": "md-default",
  "md/hover": "md-default",
  "md/disabled": "md-default",
  "lg/default": "lg-default",
  "lg/hover": "lg-default",
  "lg/disabled": "lg-default",
};

export function Button({ size = "md", state = "default", label = "Button", icon = <IconCheck />, showIcon = false, children, className }: ButtonProps) {
  const variant = VARIANTS[`${size}/${state}`] ?? "md-default";
  switch (variant) {
    case "lg-default":
      return (
        <div className={cx("relative w-fit h-auto flex flex-row gap-2 items-center justify-center py-3 px-6 bg-[color:var(--color-brand,#4f46e5)] rounded-[10px]", className)} data-variant={variant} />
      );
    default:
      return (
        <button className={cx("relative w-fit h-auto flex flex-row gap-2 items-center justify-center py-2 px-4 bg-[color:var(--color-brand,#4f46e5)] rounded-[8px]", className)} type="button" data-variant={variant}>
          {showIcon && icon}
          <span className="relative w-fit flex-none h-auto min-w-0 min-h-0 [font-family:'Inter',sans-serif] text-[14px] font-semibold leading-[150%] text-left text-[#ffffff] whitespace-pre">{label}</span>
        </button>
      );
  }
}

// Generated by OpenFini Proto from the design's component. Edit the design and export again, or take it over.
import { cx } from "../cx";

export interface IconCheckProps {
  className?: string;
}

export function IconCheck({ className }: IconCheckProps) {
  return (
    <div className={cx("relative w-4 h-4", className)}>
      <svg className="absolute left-[0%] top-[0%] w-full h-full overflow-visible" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 8l4 4 8-8" fill="none" fillRule="evenodd" stroke="#18181b" strokeWidth="1.5" /></svg>
    </div>
  );
}

===== src/cx.ts
/** Joins class names, skipping empty ones. */
export function cx(...names: (string | false | null | undefined)[]) {
  return names.filter(Boolean).join(" ");
}
